newsitem.title: UK: Christian Salvesen up as bid hopes revive.
newsitem.headline: Christian Salvesen up as bid hopes revive.

text.p: Shares in Christian Salvesen Plc rose in pre-market trade on Friday, after a report in the Times newspaper rekindled bid hopes around the transport group.
Salvesen shares were up 5-1/2p at 302 by 0709 GMT in volume of 60,000 shares.

The Times report noted that Salvesen shares were trading well below the level of last year's unsuccesful bid from rival Hays Plc and that Hays would be free to relaunch its approach "within a few weeks".
Salvesen shares, which touched a year's low of 235p in early June, rose as high as 411p last July in the wake of the Hays bid.
Hays shares were unchanged at 576p. No-one at Hays was immediately available for comment.
